dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable selectors, clear conflicts, and help example are implemented; no-selector flow is retained.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go adds StringArray --field/--field-id, mutual-exclusion and format conflict checks, and repeated-field example

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Resolvers perform case-insensitive matching, canonical-name headers, sorted actionable candidates, and deterministic ambiguity errors.
evidence: product.diff: resolveSelectedFields uses resolvers and headers use field.Name()

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The item query's returned fields are reused, further pages are fetched only for selectors, and errors return before rendering.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go resolveSelectedFields conditionally calls ProjectFieldsAfter
product.diff: queries.go ProjectFieldsAfter appends and paginates from initial cursor
product.diff: tests cover completing field pages and avoiding it without selected fields

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and multi-value types are rendered, with empty fallback and CR/LF normalization.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go formatFieldValue handles text, number, date, select, iteration, milestone, labels, PRs, repository, users, and reviewers
product.diff: sanitizeTableCell removes carriage returns and replaces newlines

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected canonical headers are appended in request order; each item is queried by field ID and emits one cell per selected field.
evidence: product.diff: runList resolves fields then calls printResults with them
product.diff: printResults appends headers and invokes formatFieldValue for every selected field
product.diff: end-to-end selector-order test asserts extended rendered table

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Resolution and pagination errors are returned before table construction; the focused changes reuse existing query/client types and preserve the established command path.
evidence: product.diff: runList returns resolveSelectedFields errors before printResults
product.diff: resolveSelectedFields returns ProjectFieldsAfter and resolver errors
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/item-list/item_list.go: existing owner/project/item and exporter flow retained
